pages.text: That morning, the canal was white with ice. The boat was stuck in the ice and couldn't move.
Pongi gently put a foot on the ice. It was hard.
"I'll check it first." Dad took a big step onto the ice.
Dad stood with his feet apart. "See? It doesn't bud—"
Dad plopped down onto the ice.
Dad slid gently along, still sitting. He didn't stop.
Pongi tried sitting on the ice. Away she slid.
Pongi's little brother sat down too. All three slid along, one behind another.
Nobody stood up to walk. The whole canal had turned into a slide.
